subject: general
question: Who is the author of the book 'India Divided'?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rajendra Prasad**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3594069eb4eac3d559af7c626aabe4ee4145967932cf8ad78e35476f134a4b8.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The book **India Divided** was authored by **Dr. Rajendra Prasad**, who later became the **first President of India**, serving from **1950 to 1962**.
 
• The work was primarily drafted during his imprisonment at **Bankipur Jail** in Patna between **1942 and 1945**, following his arrest during the **Quit India Movement**.
 
• Published in **1946**, the book provides a rigorous intellectual and statistical critique of the **Two-Nation Theory** proposed by the **Muslim League**.
 
• It traces the history of **Hindu-Muslim relations** and argues that the two communities had developed a common culture over centuries, making the **Partition of India** unnecessary and potentially harmful.
 
• The book is noted for its detailed analysis of the **economic and social implications** of partition, documenting how the division of resources would impact both proposed nations.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3e20068b61817b168623bbf4377a66602deb382bfb1e34ae29a5e35078dcefcb.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Jawaharlal Nehru**:

 
 
• He was the **first Prime Minister** of independent India and a key figure in the **Indian Independence Movement**.
 
• His literary contributions include **The Discovery of India**, **Glimpses of World History**, and **Letters from a Father to His Daughter**.
 
 
 
• **B.R. Ambedkar**:
 
 
• Recognized as the **Chief Architect of the Indian Constitution** and the first **Law Minister** of India.
 
• He wrote a similarly titled but distinct book called **Pakistan or the Partition of India** (1940), which examined the political and philosophical aspects of the demand for Pakistan.
 
 
 
• **Vallabhbhai Patel**:
 
 
• Known as the **Sardar** and the **Iron Man of India**, he served as the first **Home Minister** and **Deputy Prime Minister**.
 
• He is celebrated for the **political integration** of over **560 princely states** into the Indian Union.
